subject: Security review & SOC 2 package — MAP milestone: deliverables & owners
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@calyxfinance.com>, Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@calyxfinance.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: Security review & SOC 2 package (Mutual Action Plan milestone)

Thanks again for carving out time this morning — quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to keep the MAP milestone on track.

Call summary (10m):
- Topic: Calyx security review and SOC 2 evidence intake to satisfy procurement milestone.
- Outcome: We agreed on a short questionnaire + evidence checklist as the primary intake artifacts and a follow-up security deep-dive if any gaps appear.

Immediate asks / proposed owners & dates:
1) Calyx: complete and return the attached SOC 2 questionnaire (Calyx_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) — target: 2027-05-03 — owner: Emma Clark.
2) Redwood: provide evidence inventory template and example entries (evidence_inventory_template.csv) and a one-page mapping of where items typically live — due: 2027-04-30 — owner: Rishi Malhotra.
3) Security deep-dive (optional): 60-min technical session to review logging, retention, and access controls — proposed window: week of 2027-05-06 — owner: Lauren Bishop to schedule if requested.
4) Legal DPA / data flow diagram: Calyx to share any required redlines by 2027-05-07; Redwood to confirm acceptance by 2027-05-10 — owners: Mike Jackson (Calyx) / Marissa Cole (Redwood).

Dependencies and notes:
- We will not start evidence collection until the questionnaire is returned; some items (e.g., redacted audit logs) require SRE assistance — Rishi will prepare sample artifacts.
- If Calyx needs extra time on the questionnaire, please call that out; we can shift internal deliverables accordingly but want to avoid slipping the overall MAP target close.

Attached for your review: Calyx_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (questionnaire stub) and a draft MAP PDF with milestone alignment (Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf).

Next step: Emma — please confirm the questionnaire target date or propose a new one.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
[attachment: Calyx_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel, 52KB)]
[attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@calyxfinance.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@calyxfinance.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security review & SOC 2 package (Mutual Action Plan milestone)

Thanks Lauren — helpful summary. A couple of quick notes from our Security intake perspective:

- May 3 is tight for us given an internal audit next week. Can we shift the questionnaire target to 2027-05-10? If that works, we'll keep the deep-dive in the week of May 13.
- For the evidence inventory: can you include an example of a redacted log export (format and fields) so our ops team knows what to pull?
- Regarding the DPA, legal is already reviewing; I expect comments by 2027-05-06.

We want to avoid rework: if Rishi can provide a short example mapping of "questionnaire item -> example evidence file name / location" that will help.

I'll confirm the new questionnaire due date after I sync with Mike, but tentatively propose 2027-05-10.

Emma Clark
Head of Information Security | Calyx Financial
emma.clark@calyxfinance.com
[signature: Calyx Financial]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@calyxfinance.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@calyxfinance.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security review & SOC 2 package (Mutual Action Plan milestone)

Appreciate the quick reply, Emma — shifting the questionnaire to 2027-05-10 works for us. Updated MAP milestones below (please treat as the current working plan):

MAP milestone notes (updated):
- Milestone A: Questionnaire returned
  - Owner: Calyx (Emma)
  - Due: 2027-05-10
  - Dependencies: none

- Milestone B: Redwood provides evidence inventory template + example artifacts
  - Owner: Redwood (Rishi)
  - Due: 2027-04-30 (Rishi will deliver a zipped example with a redacted log sample and an annotated mapping)
  - Dependencies: none

- Milestone C: Security deep-dive session (technical)
  - Owner: Redwood (Lauren) / Calyx (Emma)
  - Target window: 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-17
  - Dependencies: Questionnaire answers to focus discussion points

- Milestone D: Legal DPA redlines and sign-off
  - Owner: Calyx Legal (Mike) / Redwood Legal (Marissa)
  - Target dates: Calyx redlines by 2027-05-06; Redwood response by 2027-05-10
- MAP target close (commercial): 2027-05-20 (tentative, conditioned on completion of Milestones A–D)

Rishi — can you confirm you can deliver the evidence inventory + one redacted log sample by 2027-04-30? I attached the current MAP draft (Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf) which highlights the milestone table.

Emma — once you confirm the 5/10 questionnaire date I'll update the HubSpot timeline (link below).

Thanks all,
Lauren

From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@calyxfinance.com>

Cc: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@calyxfinance.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security review & SOC 2 package — MAP milestone: deliverables & owners

Lauren / team — quick update: we completed the questionnaire today and uploaded the file to the shared Drive folder (link below). Attaching a copy here for your intake.

What we submitted:
- Calyx_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1_filled.xlsx (attached)
- Notes: Log export example included in tab "logs_example" (redacted).

Next steps we expect from Redwood:
- Rishi: review the questionnaire and confirm whether the redacted log sample meets the requirement or if we need a different format.
- Lauren: schedule the technical deep-dive for the week of May 13.
- Marissa: once legal comments land (Mike expects to send redlines on 2027-05-06), can you confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA timeline will allow sign-off by 2027-05-10?

Thanks — we appreciate the clear milestone plan, that makes this easier to track.

Emma Clark
Head of Information Security | Calyx Financial
